bean.name: SpiffeSecurityPolicy
bean.title: Spiffe Security Policy
bean.description: An authorization policy that authorizes a route segment on the caller's SPIFFE ID, read from the peer certificate that SPIFFE mutual TLS verified. A peer that is not accepted, or presents no verified SVID, is denied with CamelAuthorizationException.

acceptedSpiffeIds.description: Comma-separated allow-list of the peer SPIFFE IDs this route segment authorizes, for example spiffe://example.org/frontend. Set exactly one of acceptedSpiffeIds and acceptAnySpiffeId: setting both is rejected, and setting neither fails closed.

acceptAnySpiffeId.description: Authorize any peer that presents a verified SPIFFE SVID, leaving the which-peer decision to a downstream policy such as OPA. It still fails closed when no verified peer certificate is present. Mutually exclusive with acceptedSpiffeIds.

sslSessionHeader.label: advanced
sslSessionHeader.description: Name of the message header that carries the verified SSLSession the peer certificate is read from. The default is the header camel-netty and camel-netty-http populate; set it for another TLS consumer that exposes the session under a different name.
